verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll product, so cancelling or correcting a submitted payroll is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence does not show that capability. One item advises fixing inaccuracies before running payroll, which is a pre-submission check, not a correction of a submitted run. Another describes post-payment adjustments made before a quarterly deadline, which is a different capability. Neither shows cancelling or editing a submitted payroll before employees are paid.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can cancel or correct a submitted payroll before employees are paid
